english_title: Proposition 1: A Necessary Condition for Uniform Distribution Modulo 1
statement_en:
If the sequence $x_n$ is uniformly distributed modulo $1$, then its difference sequence $\Delta x_n$ must satisfy
$$\limsup_{n\to \infty} n|\Delta x_n|=+\infty.$$
